_doc: What the game says when a hit meets a creature's weakness, its resistance or what it shrugs off, or fire puts a beast to flight (src/affinity.py; Brandon, bug bash 3.3.2: 'a whole set of pokemon style messages, so you know it when you are blocked or effective'). One line per action, chosen at random from the pool; the _many pools when several creatures were struck the same way. KNOWLEDGE DECIDES WHAT IS SAID (winning-build plan 2026-11-13, section 3.1; Brandon: 'no omniscient monsters'): the hero always FEELS a hit; knowing the creature tells him WHY. A kind he does not know (family_lore.knowledge UNKNOWN) gets a 'felt' line, which never names what met it. A kind he knows only by its family (KIN) gets the felt line and the family's habit from 'habits'. A kind he knows (KNOWN: studied, its page opened, or its family at Lore) gets the top-level pools, which name the cause. {name} is the creature with its article at a sentence start, {the} the same mid-sentence, {word} what met it (fire, silver, a cutting blow); {he} {He} {him} {his} {His} are the creature's own pronouns (data/monsters.json pronoun: 'it', 'he' or 'she'; src/monster.py pronoun_fill). A 'felt' line never uses {word}. A fire fright is what the eye sees (the beast backs off from the flame) and is said the same at every level. status_immune: the line when an effect cannot take hold on a creature by its nature (Monster.add_effect, status_immune in monsters.json), by effect, said to a hero who knows the creature or its family; status_immune_felt: the same for a creature he does not know, which never says why. status_immune_will: the same for a refusal that is not the kind's nature but a named foe's will (a boss, a mini-boss or a seal demon is never frightened, charmed or, for a boss, held fast: Monster.resists_control) or the galla's fury (fearless), so a creature with a mind is never said to have none. status_weak: the line when one takes hold easily (status_weak), which is what the eye sees. {effect} is the effect's name.

habits._doc: The family's habit, said after the felt line to a hero who knows the creature's family but not the kind itself (KIN). Written from the family's (or its group's) lore in data/family_affinity.json. A key 'weak:slash' is the habit when a cutting blow met a weakness; several words share a key with commas ('resisted:slash,pierce'). The creature's group is asked first, then its family; then the family's plain 'weak', 'resisted' or 'shrugs_off' line, which names nothing. tests/test_know_your_enemy.py checks that every keyed habit is true of most of the kinds it speaks for.

A point finds nothing in the dead to kill.

weak: Flesh and fur: a beast feels a good hit like any living thing.

weak: Small things: the right hit ends them.

weak:dragonbone: Dragon bone bites scale where steel will not.
